verse.text: I will be careful to live a blameless life— when will you come to help me? I will lead a life of integrity in my own home.

video.title: Walking in Integrity | Audio Reading | Our Daily Bread Devotional

reflection: David didn't just want to look good in public — he wanted integrity where nobody else was watching but his own family. That's the real test for us as dads and husbands: are we the same man on the couch at 9pm that we are at church on Sunday? Your kids aren't grading your sermons; they're grading your example, so let today's small, unseen choices at home be the ones that build trust for a lifetime.
